question: In the case of reflection from a concave mirror, if the object distance is 5 cm and the image distance is 2 cm then magnification produced by the mirror is:
solution:
The correct answer is __**-2/5**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Formula for Magnification:**

 
 
• The magnification (m) produced by a mirror is given by the formula:
 
• m = -v/u
 
• where:
 
• v is the image dist
ance 
 
• u is the object distance 
 
• Given:
 
• Object distance (u) = 5 cm (negative sign convention) 
 
• Image distance (v) = 2 cm
 
• Calculation:
 
• m = -v/u
 
• **m = -2 / 5 **
